dimensions.label: Objective
probes: What is the single problem this solves?
Can you state the objective in one sentence?
Is the objective measurable?
Would five different readers agree on what success looks like?

dimensions.label: Users & Problem
probes: Who experiences the problem?
How do they solve it today?
How often do they hit this problem?
Is there evidence the problem is real (requests, support tickets, analytics)?

dimensions.label: Success Criteria
probes: What metric moves and by how much?
How will you know this worked?
Are the criteria falsifiable — could the feature ship and fail them?
Is there a baseline measurement for the current state?

dimensions.label: Scope
probes: What is explicitly in scope?
What is explicitly out of scope?
Are there multiple independently valuable slices?
Could this be delivered incrementally?

dimensions.label: Acceptance Criteria
probes: What must be true for this to be considered done?
Are there concrete, testable conditions?
Does each criterion describe observable behavior?
Are edge-case behaviors specified?

dimensions.label: Constraints
probes: Are there technology, platform, or regulatory constraints?
Are there timeline or resource constraints?
Are there compatibility requirements?

dimensions.label: Dependencies
probes: What other systems, teams, or services does this depend on?
Are any dependencies not yet ready?
What is the risk if a dependency slips?

dimensions.label: Risks
probes: What could go wrong?
What is the blast radius if this fails?
Are there security, privacy, or compliance risks?
Is there a rollback plan?

dimensions.label: Edge Cases
probes: What happens with empty data?
What happens at scale extremes?
What happens when a dependency is unavailable?
What are the concurrency and race-condition scenarios?

dimensions.label: Assumptions
probes: What are you assuming to be true?
Which assumptions, if wrong, would invalidate the approach?
Have any assumptions been validated?

overscoped.label: Over-scoped
overscoped.description: Too many features or services for a single deliverable; needs decomposition

conflicting_requirements.label: Conflicting Requirements
conflicting_requirements.description: Requirements that cannot all be satisfied simultaneously

solution_masquerading_as_problem.label: Solution Masquerading as Problem
solution_masquerading_as_problem.description: Input describes a solution rather than the problem to solve
